attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: whatsapp_audio_message_ingestion
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "system_service_account"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_extract_message_fields
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: webhook_payload
      field: "message"
    output: raw_message_fields

  - id: step_validate_message_fields
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_message_fields
      schema: whatsapp_audio_message_schema
    output: validated_message_fields

  - id: step_extract_audio_url
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_message_fields
      field: "audio_url"
    output: audio_url

  - id: step_extract_recipient_number
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_message_fields
      field: "recipient_number"
    output: recipient_number

  - id: step_fetch_audio_binary
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/messaging/media"
      media_url: audio_url
    output: raw_audio_binary

  - id: step_validate_audio_binary
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_audio_binary
      schema: audio_binary_schema
    output: validated_audio_binary

  - id: step_transcribe_audio
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: validated_audio_binary
      url: "https://transcription-service.internal/api/transcribe"
      method: "POST"
    output: raw_transcription_result

  - id: step_validate_transcription
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_transcription_result
      schema: transcription_result_schema
    output: validated_transcription

  - id: step_extract_transcribed_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_transcription
      field: "transcribed_text"
    output: transcribed_text

  - id: step_mask_sensitive_data
    op: encrypt_field
    params:
      input: transcribed_text
      fields:
        - "rut"
        - "phone_number"
        - "credit_card"
        - "address"
      mode: "mask"
    output: masked_text

  - id: step_classify_message
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: masked_text
      url: "https://ai-classification.internal/api/classify"
      method: "POST"
    output: raw_classification_result

  - id: step_validate_classification
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_classification_result
      schema: classification_result_schema
    output: validated_classification

  - id: step_extract_es_laboral
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_classification
      field: "es_laboral"
    output: es_laboral_flag

  - id: step_check_es_laboral
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "es_laboral_flag == true"
      input_flag: es_laboral_flag
    output: is_work_request

  - id: step_route_non_work_request
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "is_work_request == false"
      target: step_terminate_non_work
    output: route_decision

  - id: step_terminate_non_work
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "skipped"
      reason: "Message classified as non-work request"

  - id: step_lookup_producer
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: "producers"
      filter:
        recipient_number: recipient_number
    output: raw_producer_record

  - id: step_validate_producer
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_producer_record
      schema: producer_record_schema
    output: validated_producer

  - id: step_extract_producer_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_producer
      field: "producer_id"
    output: producer_id

  - id: step_prepare_client_record
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_message_fields
      mapping:
        producer_id: producer_id
        phone: recipient_number
    output: client_data

  - id: step_write_client_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: client_data
      table: "clients"
      upsert: true
    output: client_record_result

  - id: step_prepare_ticket
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_classification
      mapping:
        producer_id: producer_id
        client_id: client_record_result
        classification: validated_classification
        source: "whatsapp_audio"
    output: ticket_data

  - id: step_write_ticket
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: ticket_data
      table: "tickets"
    output: ticket_result

  - id: step_prepare_message_log
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: masked_text
      mapping:
        ticket_id: ticket_result
        message_text: masked_text
        message_type: "audio_transcription"
    output: message_log_data

  - id: step_write_message_log
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: message_log_data
      table: "ticket_messages"
    output: message_log_result

  - id: step_audit_log
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: message_log_data
      action: "whatsapp_audio_ingested"
      details:
        ticket_id: ticket_result
        producer_id: producer_id

      field: audio_url
    output: audio_url

  - id: step_extract_recipient_number
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: message_payload
      field: recipient_number
    output: recipient_number

  - id: step_fetch_audio_binary
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: /api/messaging/media
      media_url: audio_url
    output: raw_audio_binary

  - id: step_validate_audio_binary
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_audio_binary
      schema: audio_binary_schema
    output: validated_audio_binary

  - id: step_transcribe_audio
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: validated_audio_binary
      url: https://transcription-service.internal/api/transcribe
      method: POST
    output: raw_transcription_result

  - id: step_validate_transcription
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_transcription_result
      schema: transcription_result_schema
    output: validated_transcription

  - id: step_extract_transcribed_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_transcription
      field: transcribed_text
    output: transcribed_text

  - id: step_mask_transcribed_text
    op: encrypt_field
    params:
      input: transcribed_text
      field: sensitive_data
      mode: mask
    output: masked_text

  - id: step_classify_message
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: masked_text
      url: https://ai-classification.internal/api/classify
      method: POST
    output: raw_classification_result

  - id: step_validate_classification
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_classification_result
      schema: classification_result_schema
    output: validated_classification

  - id: step_extract_es_laboral
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_classification
      field: es_laboral
    output: es_laboral_flag

  - id: step_check_es_laboral
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: es_laboral_flag
      rule: is_true
    output: is_work_request

  - id: step_route_non_work_request
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: is_work_request == false
      target: step_terminate_non_work

  - id: step_lookup_producer
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: producers
      filter_field: recipient_number
      filter_value: recipient_number
    output: raw_producer_record

  - id: step_validate_producer
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_producer_record
      schema: producer_record_schema
    output: validated_producer

  - id: step_prepare_client_record
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: message_payload
      mapping:
        producer: validated_producer
        recipient_number: recipient_number
        source: whatsapp_audio
    output: client_data

  - id: step_write_client_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: client_data
      table: clients
      upsert: true
    output: client_record_result

  - id: step_validate_client_record_result
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: client_record_result
      schema: client_record_result_schema
    output: validated_client_record_result

  - id: step_prepare_ticket
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_classification
      mapping:
        producer: validated_producer
        client: validated_client_record_result
        classification_result: validated_classification
        source: whatsapp_audio
    output: ticket_data

  - id: step_write_ticket
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: ticket_data
      table: tickets
    output: ticket_result

  - id: step_validate_ticket_result
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: ticket_result
      schema: ticket_result_schema
    output: validated_ticket_result

  - id: step_prepare_message_log
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: masked_text
      mapping:
        ticket: validated_ticket_result
        message_text: masked_text
        message_type: audio_transcription
    output: message_log_data

  - id: step_write_message_log
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: message_log_data
      table: ticket_messages
    output: message_log_result

  - id: step_validate_message_log_result
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: message_log_result
      schema: message_log_result_schema
    output: validated_message_log_result

  - id: step_log_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: masked_text
      action: whatsapp_audio_ingested

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: completed

  - id: step_terminate_non_work
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: skipped
      reason: message_not_eligible_for_ticket
